scripts.mobile: bash scripts/lane-env.sh npm run start --workspace apps/mobile
scripts.server: bash scripts/lane-env.sh npm run dev --workspace apps/server
scripts.e2e: bash scripts/lane-env.sh npm run e2e --workspace e2e
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && echo '' && echo 'Note: unit tests only. Run npm run test:all before pushing - database-backed tests did not run.'
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:lanes: bash scripts/test-lane-env.sh && bash scripts/test-lane-clean.sh && bash scripts/test-lane-abandon.sh
scripts.lane:list: bash scripts/lane-env.sh npm run lane:list --workspace apps/server
scripts.lane:down: bash scripts/lane-env.sh npm run lane:down --workspace apps/server --
scripts.db:migrate: bash scripts/lane-env.sh npm run db:migrate --workspace apps/server
scripts.db:reseed: bash scripts/lane-env.sh npm run db:reseed --workspace apps/server
scripts.dict:export: bash scripts/lane-env.sh npm run dict:export --workspace apps/server
scripts.dict:restore: bash scripts/lane-env.sh npm run dict:restore --workspace apps/server
